items.title: Reduce manual work with expanded Availability Blocks in Mews Operations
items.summary: Availability Blocks now support multiple occupancy levels and rates within the same space category, accurate pick-up tracking as guest counts change, product rules inherited from the parent rate, adding existing reservation groups to a block without rebuilding it, an updated Availability Block Report to spot blocks needing attention, and connected-space relationships factored into availability.
items.pitch: Group bookings used to mean manual workarounds to keep occupancy, rates, products, and pick-up in sync. Availability Blocks now handle that automatically, so Sales, Reservations, and Revenue teams spend less time reconciling and more time selling.
items.segmentation: Available to all users except Strawberry properties (Tier 3)

items.title: Germany E-Invoicing (Tier 2)
items.summary: Release-note ticket resolved for Germany B2B/B2G e-invoicing: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0.18 and XRechnung formats (EN 16931), including the Leitweg-ID requirement for public-sector invoices. Relevant to ~1,058 German PMS customers ahead of the phased mandate (reception since 2025, sending 2027–2028).
items.segmentation: Germany. Release note ticket is Done in Jira but no entry is visible yet on releases.mews.com — confirm availability/packaging (Compliance Suite) with Product Compliance (Ruben Rebato) before quoting pricing.

items.title: Norway B2B e-Invoicing — coming soon
items.summary: From 1 January 2027 all businesses with Norwegian bookkeeping obligations must issue structured B2B e-invoices. Mews is delivering a Peppol/EHF integration via Marketplace with Invopop (same engine as Belgium and Denmark), targeted for GA end of September 2026. An in-app 'coming soon' notice went to the Norway segment; customers should prepare their organisasjonsnummer.
items.segmentation: Norway properties only (300+ affected). GA date is a target, not yet published — a second 'integration live' message will follow at GA.

items.title: Mews → Flexkeeping Task Sync (Tier 1)
items.summary: Mews tasks now sync automatically to Flexkeeping in real time: a task created in Mews appears in the correct Flexkeeping user-group queue within 30 seconds, and completion in Flexkeeping updates Mews automatically — no duplicate entry.

items.title: Trial Balance by week, month, or any period in Mews Operations
items.summary: The Trial Balance moves from daily-only Excel/PDF exports into a live, interactive report inside Mews. Finance teams can select any date range, view summarized ledger data directly in Mews, and export to Excel, CSV, or PDF via the Export queue. Feature planned for late September 2026; the release-note ticket (TW-1794) was resolved on 28 Sep, so GA is imminent but not yet on releases.mews.com.
items.pitch: Month-end close without stitching daily Trial Balance files together.
items.segmentation: Segmented release to properties in United States, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico.

items.title: Manage languages and services on Central products (Mews Multi-Property)
items.summary: Central products can now carry multiple languages, which propagate automatically to local-level products. Central and local-level products are now linked via a Central service instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Central products just got more flexible — multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically, and linking products no longer means juggling service keys.

items.title: Scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers in Mews Operations
items.summary: Properties can set up recurring, scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers with custom frequency and automatic delivery, instead of running them manually every time.
items.pitch: Set the schedule once and the ledger data lands automatically, right when finance needs it for reconciliation.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews Operations users (Tier 3).

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Configure how much guests typically spend beyond the room (dining, spa, etc.), daily or per stay, with seasonal adjustments. Mews RMS adds that expected spend to the room rate when valuing a booking, so rate recommendations reflect total revenue potential.
items.pitch: Sharper pricing intelligence, not an upsell feature: revenue teams price for what a booking is actually worth to the property, not just the room.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews RMS users (Tier 3).

items.title: Charts added for feature parity between Mews RMS and Atomize
items.summary: Two additional charts were added to the daily view in Mews RMS as part of reaching feature parity between Mews RMS and Atomize.
items.segmentation: Mews RMS users. Jira release-note ticket only — no public release note found; keep to 'RMS daily view has new charts' unless the customer asks for detail.

items.title: Ledger Activity Report focused on meaningful movements
items.summary: The Ledger Activity Report now hides self-balancing postings that net to zero within the selected date range, groups remaining entries by source item, and gives every 0% VAT posting its own zero-value entry in the tax ledger.
items.pitch: A clarity upgrade: meaningful movements are easier to find and the tax audit trail is complete for 0% VAT postings.

items.title: Mews Bank Account — USA pilot (release-note ticket closed)
items.summary: A Tier 2 release-note ticket for 'Mews Bank Account (USA Pilot Launch)' was closed in Jira on 29 Sep. The ticket is an auto-created copy marked [Planning] with no release date or content, so this is a planning signal, not evidence of a launch. No mention in #prod-roadmap-updates or on releases.mews.com.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. US pilot only, timing unknown.

items.title: Duna live as default KYB provider (replacing Trulioo)
items.summary: Fintech-core reported in #rnd that Duna GA feature flags were switched on 15 Sep: new KYB (business verification) submissions now route through Duna instead of Trulioo; in-flight Trulioo processes continue unchanged. Positioned as a simpler self-service onboarding flow and groundwork for the 2027 EMI licence. Internal FAQ and onboarding brief exist; no public announcement.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Onboarding/payments teams may see a different KYB flow for new merchants — route questions to #duna-migration-ask-me-anything.

items.title: Automations, Guest Messaging & Nova — targeting GA October 1
items.summary: #gtm-rnd states Mews Automations, Guest Messaging, and Nova are targeting a joint GA on 1 October 2026. The Automations beta was extended to finish a pre-activation safety-review agent; Guest Messaging is available only to Early Access customers with Automations enabled. Explicit internal instruction: HOLD all announcements (PR, LinkedIn, release notes) until 1 October. Customers asking for Messaging can have their enterpriseId shared in #rnd-foh-guestjourney to be enabled early.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Do NOT announce Automations, Guest Messaging, or Nova before October 1 — check this digest again after that date.
